def fetch(url, path, headers=None, timeout=300):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)

def bk_file(key):
    uid = BK[key]
    durl = "https://www.blenderkit.com/api/v1/downloads/%s/" % uid
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + uid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p
    errs = []
    for host_url in [durl, durl.replace("www.blenderkit.com", "api.blenderkit.com")]:
        try:
            h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
            q = host_url + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60)
            fp = json.loads(r.read().decode())["filePath"]
            fetch(fp, p)
            return p
        except Exception as e:

def mat(name, col=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), rough=0.5, metal=0.0, emit=None, es=1.0, alpha=1.0, coat=0.0):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    try: b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
    except Exception: pass
    if emit:
        b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*emit, 1)
        b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = es
    MATS[name] = m
    return m

def texmat(name, tex, scale=1.0, tint=(1, 1, 1), rough_mul=1.0, bump=1.0):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; L = nt.links
    b = N.get("Principled BSDF")
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord"); mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (scale, scale, scale)
    L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    def img(kind, noncolor):
        p = ph_tex(tex, kind)
        if not p: return None
        n = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage"); n.image = bpy.data.images.load(p, check_existing=True)
        n.projection = "BOX"; n.projection_blend = 0.25
        if noncolor: n.image.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n.inputs["Vector"]); return n
    d = img("diff", False)
    if d:
        mix = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); mix.data_type = "RGBA"; mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mix.inputs["Factor"].default_value = 1.0
        L.new(d.outputs["Color"], mix.inputs[6]); mix.inputs[7].default_value = (*tint, 1)
        L.new(mix.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    else:
        b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*tint, 1)
    r = img("rough", True)
    if r:
        mr = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mr.operation = "MULTIPLY"; mr.inputs[1].default_value = rough_mul
        L.new(r.outputs["Color"], mr.inputs[0]); L.new(mr.outputs[0], b.inputs["Roughness"])
    n = img("nor_gl", True)
    if n:
        nm = N.new("ShaderNodeNormalMap"); nm.inputs["Strength"].default_value = bump
        L.new(n.outputs["Color"], nm.inputs["Color"]); L.new(nm.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
    MATS[name] = m
    return m

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mesh helpers
def mk(name, bm, m=None, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=False, parent=None, coll=None):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    if smooth:
        for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    if m: o.data.materials.append(m)
    o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return link(o, coll)

def box(name, size, loc, m=None, bevel=0.0, rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None, seg=2):
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    for v in bm.verts: v.co = Vector((v.co.x * size[0], v.co.y * size[1], v.co.z * size[2]))
    o = mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, parent=parent)
    if bevel > 0:
        b = o.modifiers.new("bv", "BEVEL"); b.width = bevel; b.segments = seg; b.limit_method = "ANGLE"
        for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    return o

def cyl(name, r, h, loc, m=None, seg=32, rot=(0, 0, 0), r2=None, parent=None, smooth=True):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=seg, radius1=r, radius2=(r if r2 is None else r2), depth=h)
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, smooth=smooth, parent=parent)

def sphere(name, rad, loc, m=None, scale=(1, 1, 1), parent=None, seg=(32, 16)):
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=seg[0], v_segments=seg[1], radius=rad)
    for v in bm.verts: v.co = Vector((v.co.x * scale[0], v.co.y * scale[1], v.co.z * scale[2]))
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, smooth=True, parent=parent)

def capsule(name, r, length, m, parent=None, loc=(0, 0, 0), up=False):
    """capsule from origin going down (-z) by length (or up if up=True)"""
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=24, v_segments=14, radius=r)
    for v in bm.verts:
        if v.co.z < 0: v.co.z -= length
        if up: v.co.z = -v.co.z
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, smooth=True, parent=parent)

def plane(name, w, h, loc, m=None, rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    vs = [bm.verts.new((x * w / 2, y * h / 2, 0)) for (x, y) in [(-1, -1), (1, -1), (1, 1), (-1, 1)]]
    bm.faces.new(vs)
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, parent=parent)

def empty(name, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None):
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    o.empty_display_size = 0.05

def light(name, kind, loc, energy, col=(1, 0.8, 0.6), size=0.1, rot=(0, 0, 0), spot=None):
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, kind); ld.energy = energy; ld.color = col
    if kind in ("POINT", "SPOT"): ld.shadow_soft_size = size
    if kind == "AREA": ld.size = size
    if kind == "SUN": ld.angle = size
    if spot: ld.spot_size = math.radians(spot); ld.spot_blend = 0.6
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, ld); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    return link(o)

def aim(o, target):
    d = Vector(target) - o.location

ASSET = {}
def load_asset(key):
    if key in ASSET: return ASSET[key]
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: ASSET[key] = None; return None
    try:
        with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
            dt.objects = list(df.objects)
        coll = bpy.data.collections.new("BK_" + key)
        objs = [o for o in dt.objects if o is not None]
        mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
        for o in objs:
            if o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT") or o.hide_render: continue
            coll.objects.link(o)
        dg = None
        for o in coll.objects:
            if o.type != "MESH": continue
            for c in o.bound_box:
                w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
                mn = Vector((min(mn.x, w.x), min(mn.y, w.y), min(mn.z, w.z)))
                mx = Vector((max(mx.x, w.x), max(mx.y, w.y), max(mx.z, w.z)))
        if mn.x > 1e8: raise RuntimeError("no mesh")
        coll.instance_offset = ((mn.x + mx.x) / 2, (mn.y + mx.y) / 2, mn.z)
        ASSET[key] = (coll, mx - mn)
    except Exception as e:
        NOTES.append("load " + key + " " + type(e).__name__); ASSET[key] = None
    return ASSET[key]

def place(key, loc, rotz=0.0, height=None, width=None, length=None, name=None, fallback=(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), parent=None):
    a = load_asset(key)
    if a is None:
        sz = fallback
        o = box(name or ("ph_" + key), sz, (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + sz[2] / 2), mat("fallback", (0.5, 0.1, 0.1)), rot=(0, 0, rotz))
        return o
    coll, dims = a
    s = 1.0
    if height: s = height / max(dims.z, 1e-4)
    elif width: s = width / max(dims.x, 1e-4)
    elif length: s = length / max(dims.y, 1e-4)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name or ("i_" + key), None)
    o.instance_type = "COLLECTION"; o.instance_collection = coll
    o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = (0, 0, rotz); o.scale = (s, s, s)
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return link(o)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- generic import of real objects
def import_objs(key, skip=("WGT", "cs_")):
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: return None
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
        dt.objects = list(df.objects)
    coll = bpy.data.collections.new("R_" + key); sc.collection.children.link(coll)
    objs = []

        if o is None or o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT"): continue
        if any(o.name.startswith(s) for s in skip): continue
        coll.objects.link(o); objs.append(o)
    return coll, objs

def world_bbox(objs):
    mn = Vector((1e9,) * 3); mx = Vector((-1e9,) * 3)
    for o in objs:
        if o.type != "MESH" or o.hide_render: continue
        for c in o.bound_box:
            w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
            mn = Vector(map(min, mn, w)); mx = Vector(map(max, mx, w))
    return mn, mx

def holder_for(objs, name):
    """parent all top-level objects to a new empty (keep transforms)."""
    h = empty(name)
    for o in objs:
        if o.parent is None:
            mw = o.matrix_world.copy(); o.parent = h; o.matrix_parent_inverse = Matrix.Identity(4); o.matrix_world = mw
    return h

def bill_mat(name, img_tex=True, burn=0.0, edge=False, tint=(1, 1, 1)):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; L = nt.links
    b = N.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.78
    uv = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    img = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage"); img.image = EDGE_IMG if edge else BILL_IMG
    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], img.inputs["Vector"])
    tintn = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); tintn.data_type = "RGBA"; tintn.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"; tintn.inputs["Factor"].default_value = 1.0
    L.new(img.outputs["Color"], tintn.inputs[6]); tintn.inputs[7].default_value = (*tint, 1)
    # burn mask: object property "burn" (0..1) * noise, keep one corner readable (uv x>0.78, y>0.62)
    attr = N.new("ShaderNodeAttribute"); attr.attribute_type = "OBJECT"; attr.attribute_name = "burn"
    noise = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 7.0; noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 8.0
    L.new(uv.outputs["Object"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"); L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], sep.inputs[0])
    cx = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); cx.inputs[1].default_value = 0.62; cx.inputs[2].default_value = 0.92; cx.inputs[3].default_value = 0.0; cx.inputs[4].default_value = 0.55
    L.new(sep.outputs[0], cx.inputs[0])
    cy = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); cy.inputs[1].default_value = 0.45; cy.inputs[2].default_value = 0.85; cy.inputs[3].default_value = 0.0; cy.inputs[4].default_value = 0.55
    L.new(sep.outputs[1], cy.inputs[0])
    corner = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); corner.operation = "MINIMUM"; L.new(cx.outputs[0], corner.inputs[0]); L.new(cy.outputs[0], corner.inputs[1])
    if edge: corner.inputs[1].default_value = 0.0
    sub = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); sub.operation = "SUBTRACT"; L.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], sub.inputs[0]); L.new(corner.outputs[0], sub.inputs[1])
    mul = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mul.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(attr.outputs["Fac"], mul.inputs[0]); mul.inputs[1].default_value = 1.6
    thr = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); thr.operation = "ADD"; L.new(sub.outputs[0], thr.inputs[0]); L.new(mul.outputs[0], thr.inputs[1])
    mr = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); mr.inputs[1].default_value = 0.95; mr.inputs[2].default_value = 1.12; L.new(thr.outputs[0], mr.inputs[0])
    char = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); char.data_type = "RGBA"; L.new(mr.outputs[0], char.inputs["Factor"])
    L.new(tintn.outputs[2], char.inputs[6]); char.inputs[7].default_value = (0.012, 0.010, 0.009, 1)
    L.new(char.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    # ember rim: where thr is just below the char threshold, glow orange * ember property
    ea = N.new("ShaderNodeAttribute"); ea.attribute_type = "OBJECT"; ea.attribute_name = "ember"
    rim = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); rim.inputs[1].default_value = 0.86; rim.inputs[2].default_value = 0.98; L.new(thr.outputs[0], rim.inputs[0])
    rim2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); rim2.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(rim.outputs[0], rim2.inputs[0])
    inv = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); inv.operation = "SUBTRACT"; inv.inputs[0].default_value = 1.0; L.new(mr.outputs[0], inv.inputs[1])
    L.new(inv.outputs[0], rim2.inputs[1])
    em = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); em.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(rim2.outputs[0], em.inputs[0]); L.new(ea.outputs["Fac"], em.inputs[1])
    em2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); em2.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(em.outputs[0], em2.inputs[0]); em2.inputs[1].default_value = 30.0

def uvbox(name, size, loc, mats, rot=(0, 0, 0), bevel=0.0, parent=None, jitter=0.0, subdiv=0):
    """box with per-face UVs (each face 0..1); mats = (top/bottom material, side material)."""
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    if subdiv:
        bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(bm, edges=bm.edges[:], cuts=subdiv, use_grid_fill=True)
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co = Vector((v.co.x * size[0], v.co.y * size[1], v.co.z * size[2]))
        if jitter:
            v.co += Vector((random.uniform(-1, 1) * jitter, random.uniform(-1, 1) * jitter, random.uniform(-1, 1) * jitter * 0.6))
    uvl = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
    for f in bm.faces:
        n = f.normal
        top = abs(n.z) > 0.7
        f.material_index = 0 if top else 1
        for lp in f.loops:
            c = lp.vert.co
            if top: u, v = c.x / size[0] + 0.5, c.y / size[1] + 0.5
            elif abs(n.x) > 0.7: u, v = c.y / size[1] + 0.5, c.z / size[2] + 0.5
            else: u, v = c.x / size[0] + 0.5, c.z / size[2] + 0.5
            lp[uvl].uv = (u, v)
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    for mm in mats: me.materials.append(mm)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    link(o)
    if bevel:
        bv = o.modifiers.new("bv", "BEVEL"); bv.width = bevel; bv.segments = 2; bv.limit_method = "ANGLE"
    for p_ in me.polygons: p_.use_smooth = bool(jitter)
    o["burn"] = 0.0; o["ember"] = 0.0
    return o

def bill_plane(name, wh, loc, rot=(0, 0, 0), keep=1.0, parent=None):
    """single banknote (or fragment): plane with UVs; 'keep' cuts away the left part via alpha (burnt edge)."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    nx, ny = 16, 6
    verts = [[bm.verts.new(((i / nx - 0.5) * wh[0], (j / ny - 0.5) * wh[1], 0)) for i in range(nx + 1)] for j in range(ny + 1)]
    uvl = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
    for j in range(ny):
        for i in range(nx):
            f = bm.faces.new([verts[j][i], verts[j][i + 1], verts[j + 1][i + 1], verts[j + 1][i]])
            for lp in f.loops:
                c = lp.vert.co; lp[uvl].uv = (c.x / wh[0] + 0.5, c.y / wh[1] + 0.5)
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.z += 0.002 * math.sin(v.co.x * 40) * math.sin(v.co.y * 50)
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    link(o)
    o["burn"] = 0.0; o["ember"] = 0.0; o["keep"] = keep
    me.materials.append(frag_mat())
    return o

def frag_mat():
    if "frag" in MATS: return MATS["frag"]
    base = bill_mat("frag_base")
    m = base.copy(); m.name = "frag"
    nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; L = nt.links
    b = N.get("Principled BSDF")
    uv = [n for n in N if n.type == "TEX_COORD"][0]
    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"); L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], sep.inputs[0])
    kp = N.new("ShaderNodeAttribute"); kp.attribute_type = "OBJECT"; kp.attribute_name = "keep"
    noise = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 12.0; noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 6.0
    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
    nz = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); nz.operation = "MULTIPLY_ADD"; nz.inputs[1].default_value = 0.12; nz.inputs[2].default_value = -0.06
    L.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], nz.inputs[0])
    edge = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); edge.operation = "SUBTRACT"; edge.inputs[0].default_value = 1.0; L.new(kp.outputs["Fac"], edge.inputs[1])
    x = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); x.operation = "ADD"; L.new(sep.outputs[0], x.inputs[0]); L.new(nz.outputs[0], x.inputs[1])
    d = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); d.operation = "SUBTRACT"; L.new(x.outputs[0], d.inputs[0]); L.new(edge.outputs[0], d.inputs[1])
    alpha = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); alpha.operation = "GREATER_THAN"; alpha.inputs[1].default_value = 0.0; L.new(d.outputs[0], alpha.inputs[0])
    L.new(alpha.outputs[0], b.inputs["Alpha"])
    # charred rim near the cut
    rim = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); rim.inputs[1].default_value = 0.0; rim.inputs[2].default_value = 0.05; rim.inputs[3].default_value = 1.0; rim.inputs[4].default_value = 0.0
    L.new(d.outputs[0], rim.inputs[0])
    mixc = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); mixc.data_type = "RGBA"; L.new(rim.outputs[0], mixc.inputs["Factor"])
    prev = b.inputs["Base Color"].links[0].from_socket
    L.new(prev, mixc.inputs[6]); mixc.inputs[7].default_value = (0.02, 0.015, 0.01, 1)
    L.new(mixc.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    setattr_safe(m, "surface_render_method", "DITHERED")
    setattr_safe(m, "blend_method", "CLIP")
    MATS["frag"] = m
    return m

def smoke_mat(name, col=(0.05, 0.05, 0.055), dens=6.0, warm=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; L = nt.links
    for n in list(N): N.remove(n)
    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
    pv = N.new("ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled"); pv.inputs["Color"].default_value = (*col, 1)
    pv.inputs["Anisotropy"].default_value = 0.3
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    noise = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); noise.noise_dimensions = "4D"; noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 3.0; noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 6.0
    noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.6
    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping"); L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
    wv = N.new("ShaderNodeValue"); wv.name = "W"; wv.label = "W"; L.new(wv.outputs[0], noise.inputs["W"])
    # vertical fade + sphere falloff around generated centre
    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"); L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], sep.inputs[0])
    grad = N.new("ShaderNodeTexGradient"); grad.gradient_type = "SPHERICAL"
    m2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping"); m2.inputs["Location"].default_value = (-0.5, -0.5, -0.5)
    L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], m2.inputs["Vector"]); m2.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (2, 2, 2)
    L.new(m2.outputs["Vector"], grad.inputs["Vector"])
    ramp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); ramp.inputs[1].default_value = 0.42; ramp.inputs[2].default_value = 0.75
    L.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs[0])
    mul = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mul.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(ramp.outputs[0], mul.inputs[0]); L.new(grad.outputs["Fac"], mul.inputs[1])
    amt = N.new("ShaderNodeValue"); amt.name = "AMT"; amt.label = "AMT"
    mul2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mul2.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(mul.outputs[0], mul2.inputs[0]); L.new(amt.outputs[0], mul2.inputs[1])
    mul3 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mul3.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(mul2.outputs[0], mul3.inputs[0]); mul3.inputs[1].default_value = dens
    L.new(mul3.outputs[0], pv.inputs["Density"])
    if warm:
        pv.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.35, 0.08, 1)
        e = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); e.operation = "MULTIPLY"; L.new(mul2.outputs[0], e.inputs[0]); e.inputs[1].default_value = warm
        L.new(e.outputs[0], pv.inputs["Emission Strength"])
    L.new(pv.outputs[0], out.inputs["Volume"])
    return m

def smoke_obj(name, loc, size, col=(0.05, 0.05, 0.055), dens=6.0, warm=0.0):
    o = box(name, size, loc, None)

CH = {}
@safe
def import_char(key, tag):
    r = import_objs(key)
    if not r: return None
    coll, objs = r
    arms = [o for o in objs if o.type == "ARMATURE"]
    arm = max(arms, key=lambda a: len(a.data.bones))
    keep = set()
    def anc(o):
        p = o.parent
        while p is not None:
            if p == arm: return True
            p = p.parent
        return False
    for o in objs:
        if o == arm or anc(o): keep.add(o)
        elif o.type == "MESH" and any(m.type == "ARMATURE" and m.object == arm for m in o.modifiers): keep.add(o)
    for o in objs:
        if o not in keep:
            coll.objects.unlink(o)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    mw = arm.matrix_world.copy()
    if arm.parent is not None:
        arm.parent = None; arm.matrix_world = mw
    for o in keep:
        if o == arm: continue
        if not anc(o):
            w = o.matrix_world.copy(); o.parent = arm; o.matrix_parent_inverse = arm.matrix_world.inverted(); o.matrix_world = w
    rig43.strip_rig(arm)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    rg = rig43.Rig(tag, arm)
    Rr = rg.R
    meshes = [o for o in keep if o.type == "MESH" and not o.hide_render]
    mn, mx = world_bbox(meshes)
    hl = arm.matrix_world @ arm.data.bones[Rr["armL"][0]].head_local
    hr = arm.matrix_world @ arm.data.bones[Rr["armR"][0]].head_local
    fl = arm.matrix_world @ arm.data.bones[Rr["footL"]].head_local
    fr = arm.matrix_world @ arm.data.bones[Rr["footR"]].head_local
    left = hl - hr
    a = math.atan2(left.y, left.x)
    c = (fl + fr) / 2
    M_al = Matrix.Rotation(-a, 4, "Z") @ Matrix.Translation(Vector((-c.x, -c.y, -mn.z))) @ arm.matrix_world
    h = empty("CH_" + tag)
    arm.parent = h; arm.matrix_parent_inverse = Matrix.Identity(4); arm.matrix_basis = M_al
    rg.setup(M_al)
    rg.holder = h
    rg.meshes = meshes
    # blink shape keys
    rg.blink = []
    for o in meshes:
        if o.data.shape_keys:
            for kb in o.data.shape_keys.key_blocks:
                if "eyeclose" in kb.name.lower() or "blink" in kb.name.lower(): rg.blink.append(kb)
    LAYOUT["rig_" + tag] = {"type": rg.type, "height": round(rg.height, 3), "hip0": [round(x, 3) for x in rg.hip0], "Lu": round(rg.Lu["L"], 3), "Lf": round(rg.Lf["L"], 3),
                            "Lt": round(rg.Lt["L"], 3), "Ls": round(rg.Ls["L"], 3), "sh0": [round(x, 3) for x in rg.sh0["L"]], "head0": [round(x, 3) for x in rg.head0], "blink": len(rg.blink),
                            "roles": {k: v for k, v in Rr.items()}}
    CH[tag] = rg
    return rg

    d = Vector((p[0] - pos[0], p[1] - pos[1], p[2]))

def L2W(p, pos, yaw):
    v = Matrix.Rotation(D(yaw), 3, "Z") @ Vector(p)
    return Vector((v.x + pos[0], v.y + pos[1], v.z))

class Track:
    """keyed states: (t, pos(x,y), yaw, spec, world_hands{L/R: world point})."""
    def __init__(self, rg): self.rg = rg; self.keys = []
    def add(self, t, pos, yaw, spec=None, hw=None, ease=True):
        self.keys.append((t, pos, yaw, spec or {}, hw or {}, ease)); return self
    def state(self, t):
        ks = self.keys
        if t <= ks[0][0]: i0 = i1 = 0; k = 0.0
        elif t >= ks[-1][0]: i0 = i1 = len(ks) - 1; k = 0.0
        else:
            for i in range(len(ks) - 1):
                if ks[i][0] <= t <= ks[i + 1][0]: i0, i1 = i, i + 1; break
            u = (t - ks[i0][0]) / max(1e-6, ks[i1][0] - ks[i0][0])
            k = C.ss(u) if ks[i1][5] else u
        a, b = ks[i0], ks[i1]
        base = P0(self.rg)
        sa = S(base, **a[3]); sb = S(base, **b[3])
        for side in "LR":
            if side in a[4]: sa["hand" + side] = tuple(W2L(a[4][side], a[1], a[2]))
            if side in b[4]: sb["hand" + side] = tuple(W2L(b[4][side], b[1], b[2]))
        spec = rig43.blend(sa, sb, k)
        pos = C.lerp(a[1], b[1], k); yaw = C.lerp(a[2], b[2], k)
        # walking: feet step when the holder moves
        dist = math.dist(a[1], b[1])
        if dist > 0.2 and 0 < k < 1 and i0 != i1:
            dur = b[0] - a[0]
            ph = (t - a[0]) / dur * max(2, round(dist / 0.32)) * math.pi
            for side, sg in (("L", 1), ("R", -1)):
                f = list(spec["foot" + side])
                sw = math.sin(ph + (0 if side == "L" else math.pi))
                f[1] += -0.16 * sw
                f[2] += 0.07 * max(0.0, math.cos(ph + (0 if side == "L" else math.pi)))
                spec["foot" + side] = tuple(f)
            h = list(spec["hip"]); h[2] += 0.02 * abs(math.sin(ph)); spec["hip"] = tuple(h)
            for side, sg in (("L", 1), ("R", -1)):
                if side not in a[4] and side not in b[4] and ("hand" + side) not in a[3]:
                    hh = list(spec["hand" + side]); hh[1] += 0.12 * math.sin(ph + (math.pi if side == "L" else 0)); spec["hand" + side] = tuple(hh)
        return pos, yaw, spec

def extras(tag, t, pos, yaw, spec):

            h = list(spec["handR"]); h[1] += 0.03 * max(0.0, math.sin((t - 1.25) * 30)); spec["handR"] = tuple(h)
        if 41.0 < t < 42.85 or 43.25 < t < 43.7:  # foot tap
            f = list(spec["footR"]); f[2] += 0.05 * max(0.0, math.sin(t * 16)); spec["footR"] = tuple(f)
        if 33.2 < t < 33.8:  # knuckle crack push
            for s_ in "LR":
                h = list(spec["hand" + s_]); h[1] -= 0.02 * math.sin((t - 33.2) * 40); spec["hand" + s_] = tuple(h)
    if tag == "R":
        if 1.78 < t < 2.32 or 46.72 < t < 47.36:  # happy bob
            hd = list(spec["head"]); hd[1] += 9 * math.sin(t * 13); spec["head"] = tuple(hd)

    if tag == "E":

            h = list(spec["handR"]); h[2] += 0.025 * max(0.0, math.sin((t - 29.6) * 28)); spec["handR"] = tuple(h)
    return spec

def key_char(tag, f, t):
    rg = CH[tag]; T = TR[tag]
    ta = anim_time(t)

    spec = extras(tag, ta, pos, yaw, spec)
    h = rg.holder

    h.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f); h.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
    basis = rg.solve(spec)
    pb = rg.arm.pose.bones
    for b, M in basis.items():
        if b not in rg.role_of: continue
        loc, rot, sca = M.decompose()
        q0 = QPREV.get((tag, b))
        if q0 is not None and q0.dot(rot) < 0: rot.negate()
        QPREV[(tag, b)] = rot.copy()
        p = pb[b]; p.rotation_quaternion = rot; p.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=f)
        if rg.role_of[b][0] == "ctl":
